content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online has traditionally relied on platforms like PayPal and Gumroad, which impose substantial fees and restrictions. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can quickly add up and erode your profits. With NOWPayments integrated into the COREMERCH stack, you only pay a mere 0.5% fee per transaction. This means that with 100 sales per month of a $97 product, you save $921 compared to using Gumroad, allowing for greater revenue retention and investment back into your creative projects.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH infrastructure utilizes a combination of free and accessible tools to create a seamless selling experience. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments in real-time, verifying transactions on-chain. This architecture not only ensures that you own everything after deployment but also provides a reliable and scalable method to deliver your beats automatically without depending on restrictive payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is crafted specifically for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where conventional payment services are often unavailable or unreliable. It empowers musicians, producers, and beat makers to sell their work directly to audiences without intermediaries. By utilizing this infrastructure, creators can circumvent the limitations imposed by platform-based fees and regain control over their revenue streams, ensuring that every transaction positively impacts their bottom line.
Eliminate high fees and unlock more profits by using NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH system integrates several essential components to function effectively. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefronts, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script facilitate smooth order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets act as a database to manage orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 provides secure file delivery. NOWPayments ensures that cryptocurrency transactions are processed efficiently, allowing for real-time payment confirmations. This combination creates a reliable and efficient ecosystem for selling beats online.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by choosing the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. Register for a GitHub or Cloudflare account to host your store. Set up your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency. Finally, ensure your delivery method is operational via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You can find additional resources and templates by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
